description: This file defines the custom exception class 'IdentifierNotUniqueException', which extends 'PatientIdentifierException' to indicate that a patient identifier is not unique.

classes.description: Custom exception indicating a patient identifier is not unique, extending PatientIdentifierException.

methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message and a cause.
